name: Scatec ASA
summary: Scatec ASA, together with its subsidiaries, provides renewable energy solutions. The company operates through Power Production and Development & Construction segments. It produces and sells solar, wind, and hydro generated electricity. The company also develops, builds, owns, and operates solar, wind, and hydro power plants; and storage solutions, including solar, wind, hydropower, battery storage and hybrid systems. The company is also involved in the engineering, procurement, and construction activities. It has operations in South Africa, Egypt, Ukraine, Malaysia, Pakistan, Jordan, Honduras, the Czech Republic, Botswana, Vietnam, and internationally. The company was formerly known as Scate…
